resolution: The user's ruling on the purge from req_3370: no git-snapshot ceremony for the soft-deleted packages — 'they dont need to be recoverable from git i wouldnt have deleted them if we dont need them.' Executed directly: rm'd all 112 hidden package directories and committed the deletions in one commit (c8652c501, 837 files, ~451k lines of blobs gone) along with the rename-follow folder moves from req_3369's self-heal, leaving the models tree git-clean and matching disk exactly. Tracked-content history still exists in prior commits as a side effect of git itself, but no snapshot commit was made for previously-untracked hidden packages. Flagged honestly: three 'nice'-map placements referenced purged models and will stop rendering.
